name: upgrade-implementation-pending
body:
UPGRADE TIER-4 ANCHORING (supersedes the earlier "pending" state) [autonomous]. The upgrade feature's code exists on this branch and is anchored: solution.component.upgrade owns internal/cli/upgrade.go (runUpgrade, the `kalide upgrade` handler), internal/scaffold/upgrade.go (scaffold.Upgrade — project detection, refresh, migration orchestration and end-to-end validation), internal/scaffold/refresh.go (refreshScaffold / refreshReport / writeMember), internal/scaffold/migrate.go (registeredMigrations / runMigrations / migrateLibrary) and internal/scaffold/catalog.go (the embedded known-version catalog of solution.note.upgrade-embedded-catalog). The earlier placeholder implemented-by solution.component.upgrade → internal/cli.Run was removed by the spine-backfill pass: Run is the shared dispatcher owned by solution.component.cli-commands and routes `upgrade` to runUpgrade, so it is not upgrade's entry point. See solution.note.spine-backfill-reconcile.

ORIGINAL (historical): Tier-4 for this feature was not authored when this note was written — no `upgrade` symbol existed in the scanned graph, internal/cli.Run dispatched exactly init, init-library, start, templates, version and help, and internal/scaffold had no upgrade entry point.
